exposure: Width of the 'bony roof' on Graf's standard plane ultrasound images
Ratio of the width of the 'bony roof' to the femoral head's width
Ratio of the cartilaginous acetabular roof's width (including the labrum) to the width of the femoral head
outcome: Differentiation between Graf type I and type II hips
Diagnostic certainty of the examiner in borderline cases
cohort: The study included 60 Graf type II hips and 124 randomly selected Graf type I hips identified through a hip screening service.
finding: Newly introduced linear measurements and ratios on standard plane ultrasound images can be used as additional indices to differentiate between Graf's types of centered hips, increasing diagnostic certainty in borderline cases.
cross-section timing: At the time of examination in the neonatal/infantile period
